message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 222, "amount_cents": 30660}, {"order_id": 223, "amount_cents": 23129}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I should check the order and refund data myself, since the handoff only reports W2's refund claims.
The refunds ledger matches W2's claim exactly. Next I need the orders so I can cross-check the batch before paying anyone.

The refunds match W2's claim and every refund references a real order whose amount is larger than the refund, so I see no concrete problem. I'll get each customer's net balance from the tool, starting with acme.
acme's net balance of 34895 matches its orders (33101 + 24923) minus the refund on order 223 (23129), so the figure checks out. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net balance of 30973 matches its orders (19628 + 11345) with no refunds against them, so it checks out. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
All three net balances match my hand check against the orders and refunds: cobalt is 36677 + 27011 - 30660 = 33028. Nothing looks wrong, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
acme's payout of 34895 recorded successfully. I rechecked cobalt's figure too: 36677 + 27011 - 30660 = 33028, which matches. Next I'll record birch's payout of 30973.
birch's payout of 30973 recorded successfully. cobalt's net balance of 33028 matches my hand check (36677 + 27011 - 30660), so I'll record that payout next.
All three customers have been paid. Each net balance matched my hand check against the orders and refunds, so I'm finishing with the payout totals.
